نتفلور (form IIq)
# نَتَفَلْوَرُ (natafalwaru) /na.ta.fal.wa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَلْوَرَ (tafalwara)
# نَتَفَلْوَرَ (natafalwara) /na.ta.fal.wa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَلْوَرَ (tafalwara)
# نَتَفَلْوَرْ (natafalwar) /na.ta.fal.war/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَلْوَرَ (tafalwara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
